batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: run out (SK Raina, RA Jadeja, MM Sharma)

batting.name: M Vijay
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b RA Jadeja

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c MM Sharma b BW Hilfenhaus

batting.name: LR Shukla
batting.dismissal: c IC Pandey b R Ashwin

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b WD Parnell

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b LR Shukla

balls.text: 18 off the last over! Jadhav continues to use his feet and Mohit bowls this a touch wider, he has to chase this one and gets an outside edge but bisects the gap neatly between point and short third man and he has outscored Duminy too
Jadhav makes up for those dots in the previous over! Mohit bowls length, Jadhav comes down the track and gets to the pitch of it and launches it over wide long-off
that should make DD feel much better! He was back on strike, he danced down the track and launched that flat over long-off
just the single and Duminy's off strike, fuller ball and drilled to long-off
Duminy looks to play the reverse paddle down to third man, quick fuller delivery outside off, didn't get bat on it
that was the leg cutter, Jadhav was down the track and he skied that over backward point, McCullum ran forward from the deep and dived and couldn't catch it, just dropped short
after three dot balls the over ends with nine, Hilfy errs by straying on the pads with the fine leg up, Duminy helps himself with a swing and sends it to deep square leg
digs out a fuller ball and it's an outside edge to third man
lucky this time, swings at a fuller ball on the stumps and gets an inside edge that trickles past short fine leg
Jadhav moves across the stumps and it's a fuller ball which he fails to dig out, three dot balls!
Jadhav fails to make contact again, outside off and a swing and a miss, Duminy has a word with him
four out of four! Over cover this time, length ball outside the off stump and he chipped it over cover and du Plessis makes a good attempt at the slide but he can only deflect it to the rope
in control of this one! Length ball on middle and leg and he whips it wide of midwicket, places it well and beats the sweeper
Duminy goes for the slog but ends up getting an outside edge down to third man, nobody there to stop it

that was comical just for Manhas scampering to stop that! Duminyu moved across the stumps and paddled that just over Manhas at square leg, he ran back and failed to catch, gathered himself quickly and scampered on all fours twice to try and stop it, good attempt but entertaining nevertheless
that's a good slower ball and he didn't pick it right, ended up chopping it towards Dhoni  but they take the single
Dhoni goes back for Mohit this time, Jadhav uses his feet and comes down the pitch but ends up chopping it down the track
flatter one and he pushes it down to point
down the track and he works it to long-on
flatter and on the stumps and he makes room and drives square but can't beat point
on the pads and whipped away to square leg
he comes down the track and forces it down to long-on
flatter one and he works it down to square leg
softly guides it down to short third man and sets off
quicker and flatter and he works it to square leg
fires that wide down the leg side again
stays back, waits for the turn and flicks it to square leg
fetches that from outside off and sweeps to deep square leg
he goes back at the crease and punches it down the ground to long-on
works it it to deep midwicket
slides it wide down the leg side
works it against the turn to square leg
takes a single to deep square leg
worked away towards short fine leg and Duminy had to head back, there's a direct hit by Smith but he is safe
stays back and works it to the on side

Vijay can't clear long-off! This was a length ball outside off and Vijay was at the crease and on his knee looking to slap that over long-off, went off the bottom half of the bat and du Plessis runs to his right and takes it
drifts on the pads and he works it to short fine leg
soft dismissal! Tossed up and he was down the track and ended up getting a leading edge that lobbed to Pandey at long-off
pushes it down to backward point for a single
the switch hit! Vijay shows he can play it too, changed his grip quickly and sent that rows over deep cover
comes round the wicket and he looks to sweep but the ball clips the body and rolls away
fired it on the pads and he clips it to short fine leg
skids through and he knocks it to the on side

Mohit's claimed the catch inches off the ground at square leg and Karthik's waiting for the umpires to have a look. Hilfenhaus came round the wicket, Karthik looked to whip it across the line and it went flat to Mohit, he dived forward and to his left and the third umpire Shamsuddin takes his time on this one and Karthik has to go
finds the big gap on the off side, this was full and wide and he didn't hit it too hard, just timing and he picks the gap at deep cover
not in control of that loft, it was a full ball and chipped down the ground and drops short of long-on
full on the stumps and worked to midwicket
he tries the same shot and moves right across the stumps but this was sprayed wide outside off, didn't make contact
innovative! Karthik improvises by shuffling across the stumps very early, exposed all three, Hilfenhaus was kind enough to bowl a full toss and Karthik scooped that over fine leg, like AB
that's a low full toss and he sweeps him down to deep square leg
tossed up and he comes down the track and chips it down to deep midwicket
works it with the turn to fine leg
drifts on the pads and worked to the leg side
clips it to the on side
slides this wide down the leg side
comes down the track and checks the shot down to long-on
defends and the ball rolls towards the keeper and Vijay responds well to the single
heads up! This was a friendly full toss and Karthik wasn't going to miss out, bashed that several rows over deep midwicket
tries to pull a length ball but mistimes it to square leg
slower ball and he pushes it down to third man
quick single, he pushes this towards point and Karthik sets off quickly, Vijay has to hurry, there's an under-arm flick to the striker's end but it's wide
shot of intent, this was a length ball on the off stump and Karthik was forward early and smashed this over mid-off
defends and the ball lands on the pitch and they try a cheeky single but decide against it
digs out a yorker down to third man
flicked off the pads down to deep midwicket
bashed that through the gap, this was a half volley outside off and he gets forward and smashes it wide of cover
good running, he pushes it down to long-on and takes the first run quickly
low full toss outside the off stump and he plays the reverse sweep down to third man
flatter delivery and he sweeps him down to square leg
comes forward and drives to long-on
gets forward and pushes it to long-on
6 + 4! This was a low full toss on the pads and swept firmly to fine leg, beat the sweeper
that was flat! Karthik was on his knee for the slog and he hit it flat and Hilfenhaus was brave to try and catch that at deep midwicket
gets forward and drives to long-on
comes forward and pushes it to the off side
works it to midwicket
punches it down to long-on
bit of confusion, he pushes this towards point and Vijay wasn't quick on the first run, he was watching the fielder, then the overthrow
plays the reverse sweep and cannot beat short third man
comes forward and drives towards cover
goes for the drive and gets an inside edge to Dhoni's boot
tossed up and he pushes it to the off side
full on middle and leg and worked to mid-on
gets away with a leading edge, looking to play this to the on side, the ball lobs up behind the bowler and du Plessis dives in vain running forward from mid-off
drifts on the pads and he mistimes the flick
on the pads and he whips it away behind square and they take three
solidly punched! He gave him a bit of width, Karthik maintained his balance well and timed it well and placed it even better wide of extra cover, bisected the gap
fetches that from outside off and pulls but straight to midwicket
punches this towards cover point and there's a fumble
keeps it tight again, on the stumps and defended down the track
fuller in length and he pushes this to the off side
he stays back and defends down the track

the off stump's down and KP's gone for a golden duck! The keeper was up to the stumps, Mohit bowled a length ball on the off stump and it skidded through, KP played down the wrong line and his stump was flattened

terrible mixup! Vijay went forward and pushed this behind point and they set off quickly and completed two, Raina dived at the boundary and parried it to Jadeja who flung it to the bowler, however Vijay was keeping his eye on the fielder and didn't want the third, de Kock had charged off for the third and was halfway down and had to scamper back, Mohit took aim and de Kock was out by miles
where did that come from? De Kock is seeing it like a football, sent this soaring over long-on and it's several rows back, fetched it from outside off, great bat speed
this was a slightly slower ball, he made room and thudded it straight to cover again
makes room and drills a low full toss down to cover
that went quickly off the bat, this was a length ball on middle and it was a pick up shot from de Kock, timed it so well and he launched that into the second tier over deep square leg
he stays beside the line and pushes it to the off side
quite stylish! After playing out a maiden Vijay responds by chipping this elegantly over mid-on, not the right length, a bit too full
another big swing and a miss, this one was bending in a bit and he swings and misses
goes over cover this time, this was a length ball outside off and he has the width to launch this over cover
finally de Kock connects well, he fetches this from outside off and swings and smashes it along the ground wide of midwicket
slower ball and a touch wide outside off, de Kock swings and misses
Hilfy fails to control the movement and he strays down the leg side
de Kock makes some room this time but he can only punch it to the off side
the maiden over has forced de Kock to go for the big hit, he misses it completely because the ball has moved away
now he brings one back in and traps him on the pads, playing across the line and shuffling, missing leg, that's a fine over, a maiden
finally Vijay gets some bat on ball, behind the line and pushed to mid-off
three out of three! Different kind of hat trick this... Pandey teases him outside off again, away movement and beaten
Pandey probes just outside the off stump, Vijay is uncertain with his movement and pokes his bat out again
this one moves away, genuine outswing from Pandey and he has Vijay chasing it and he is beaten
gets forward and across and pushes it to the off side
De Kock goes over the infield, this was a length ball on the stumps, he was forward and lofted it high over mid-on
stays beside the line and works it to the off side
good length outside off and he gets across and punches it to the off side
swings it in to the left-hander again and he knocks it to midwicket
good length on middle, better line and he flicks it to the on side
swings on the pads and he flicks it away with ease down to fine leg off the pads, Hilfenhaus bowling the wrong line

the captain does the honours! Unadkat bowls one full toss too many, it was outside off and he reached out and cracked this wide of cover who throws himself to his left in vain, raced away, that CSK's sixth consecutive win over Daredevils and their sixth in a row in this tournament
this is a low full toss and he looks to play straighter and gets an outside edge that clears cover, two added
there's the big hit! Unadkat bowls it in the spot for Dhoni to have a free swing and take him downtown, not sure how many rows over long-on but that was massive
gets away with a low full toss as Raina swung it to deep midwicket
and it's a dot ball! Parnell ends the over and his spell with a good yorker, too good for Dhoni to make something of it, he could only drill it down the track
this was a length ball which Dhoni looked to pull but played it straight to Jadhav at short midwicket

Vijay takes it at the edge of the straight boundary! It was a full ball outside off and Smith stayed at the crease and lofted it down the ground, it went really high and really tested Vijay near the rope but he kept his cool and took it nonchalantly
this was a full ball outside off and moving away and he fails to dig it out
this was a low full toss mistimed to square leg
the boundaries are bleeding, this time Raina improvises, a fast yorker outside off, he reaches out and almost guides it off the face of the bat wide of short third man and point
the over gets worse for DD, this was another slower ball and dug in short, Smith swiveled and pulled it over short fine leg
4 + 6! Shami looked for the yorker, ended uo being a knee high full toss and smoked several rows over deep midwicket
that's a poor ball! Third man was up and Shami had to bowl it short outside off, a slower ball too, Smith reached out and carved it over short third man
fires that full outside off and he drills it down to third man
Smith made room and smoked that square on the off side towards deep point, went quickly and he fumbled
this was full and wide outside off and he drills this down to Nadeem at deep cover
looked to slog that away but ended up getting an inside edge onto the body, the ball rolls back to the bowler
made room to slap that through the off side and he ended up chopping it towards short third man
digs out a yorker towards long-on and he sets off quickly and Raina completes the second
fires a full ball outside off and he digs it out to deep point
pitched up on the pads and he whips it down to long-on
swing and a miss and this was very close to shaving the off stump
this was fired full outside off and he drives firmly to nadeem at deep cover
Parnell attempted another yorker and it was a full toss, Raina was happy to send that a few rows over deep square leg. Looks like the rain is making it hard for Parnell to grip the ball
didn't expect that to reach the boundary but that was quality timing by Raina, this was a yorker and the flicked it off the middle of the bat and bisected the gap between two men at deep midwicket
that's a good yorker and he manages to dig it out for a single to midwicket
looks to play the on drive and he gets an inside edge to the boot, just a single
he fires that full on the stumps and he whips it powerfully down to deep midwicket, bat speed that
this was a slower ball and on the pads, he swings and misses and gets hit on the pad and Unadkat appeals
a lucky outside edge! This was a yorker outside off and Raina looked to dig it out and he gets an outside edge and Karthik dives in vain
follows that up with an excellent yorker, Raina nearly lost his balance trying to dig that out
makes room and mistimes it to the deep on the on side
slower ball, Raina made room and knew that third man was up and cleverly guided that wide of short third man, CSK narrowing this down with rain in the air
this was a low full toss outside off and he chips it flat but on the bounce to long-off
good length outside the off stump and he punches it to point
full on the pads and he whips it with ease wide of midwicket, the sweeper picks up
this one angles across him and he chases and misses
slower ball on the stumps and he knocks it to the off side, CSK still ahead by a run
that one rocketed off the bat! This was a length ball on the off stump and he pulled that flat and it reached deep midwicket in no time, CSK ahead by one run
these boundaries might count if it buckets down! Shukla erred by bowling on the pads, Smith swiveled and pulled this one wide of short fine leg and that's his fifty!
follows it up with a slower ball and he pushes it to the off side
flat six! This was a length ball and he gets forward and whips it flat over deep midwicket
this was short and he made room and pulled it flat and down to deep midwicket
that was a short ball and slower, Smith was too early on the pull and it deflected off the body
that's a really good yorker, aiming on middle and he did well to dig it out
full outside off and he pushes it to the off side
full outside off and he drilled it down to long-off
tried the short ball on Raina but it didn't work, not quick enough to intimidate Raina and he pulled it down to deep midwicket
saw him advance and fired that wide outside off, the umpire reckoned that had to be penalised
heads up! This rocketed off the middle of the bat, length ball and Raina bashed this flat and quick down the ground and the umpire did well to get out of the way
nearly punched this back on the full back to Shukla, he checked his shot and Shukla fields it in his follow through
finally a wicket for Delhi, this was a length ball on middle and McCullum made a bit of room to pound this over long-on, didn't time it very well and it went flat to Vijay
rare full toss from Shukla, this slipped out and McCullum waited for it and smacked it down to long-on
makes room and pushes it down to cover and they hurry the single
pushed towards long-on
cleverly tossed up and held back on the pace, big swing and a miss outside off
A pressure relieving six! This was a half tracker, he waited for it and slapped it flat and a few rows over deep midwicket
he makes room and slaps this down to long-on
flatter one and he makes room and mistimes it to the off side
testing his patience by bowling a slower ball, blind swing and a miss
strange old shot, he was looking to pull and then realised it wasn't short enough, had to check the pull and the ball rolled back to the bowler
that's a very good inswinging yorker, really had to dig that out and he nearly lost his balance
he fires it full on seeing him advance and he drills it to long-off
Baz tries the AB scoop, moved right across his stumps and looked to ramp that over the keeper but missed
fires in the yorker and he digs it out to the on side
works it behind square on the on side
sweeps too early and the ball clips his body and rolls away, half hearted appeal by Nadeem
skids through and he clips it to midwicket
stays back and punches against the turn to the off side
punched it down the track and he runs to his right and stops it
quite effortless, tossed up on middle, the arm ball and he chips this with ease over wide long-on, timed it well
he chips this down to long-off, good over

that beat everyone including Karthik, Shukla really got it to cut back in and it cut the batsman in half, cleared the stumps and Karthik somehow lost it as well and he couldn't get his glove behind it, a fine delivery but four byes, Shukla didn't deserve that
he comes down the track and gets an outside edge that rolls to third man
he makes room and punches it down to mid-off
beaten all ends up, late away movement squaring him up
Dropped by Jadhav at backward point! Would have been brilliant had he held on, this was slapped hard by McCullum, Jadhav threw himself to his right, held out his right hand but it popped out
keeps it tight again, flicked to deep square leg, just three off the over
flatter one and worked down to long-on
this was quicker and on the yorker length and he drills it to long-off, that's the 4th fifty stand between these two
spins away and he punches it towards KP at point, three dot balls
went through with the arm, made room and punched it to point
flatter one and he gets forward and defends
lands outside leg and he works it to the on side
keeps it nice and straight and he stays back and defends
this was a short of a length ball and he couldn't resist the pull, didn't fully control it and the ball dropped short of deep square leg
a bit too straight and he goes for the pull and the ball deflects off the body to the off side
keeps it nice and straight and cramps him up for room, he pushes it to the off side
Parnell drifts on the pads and he tucks it to the leg side
flatter and he punches this one down the ground, Delhi need to get both out or else it could be one-way traffic
really holds back on the pace there, Smith had to change his shot and defend
this one drifted in and he managed to get behind the line
flatter and tucked away to the on side
much better, went through with the arm and skidded, just about kept it out
this is not good bowling, Nadeem dragged this one short, McCullum was waiting for it and he pulled over midwicket
fullish outside off and pushed to the off side, Delhi can breathe better now
down the ground this time, Unadkat comes round the wicket and bowls it full, in the slot for Smith to loft through the line
flat, quick and deadly! Smith's on fire, this was the slower ball and bowled short, he swiveled and clubbed it over deep square leg, great bat speed
gets it right on the third attempt, this was dragged short and Smith swiveled and pulled it flat over fine leg
another swing, and a miss this time because he didn't read the slower ball
strange shot by Smith, he was too early on the pull and the ball deflected off his pads
another short one is punished, sat up nicely for McCullum who swiveled at the crease and hooked it over short fine leg
bad ball and equally bad shot, this was short and wide and looking to be slapped, McCullum made too much room and chopped it to cover
this was full on the pads and he looked to flick this away and the ball rolled off his pads
length ball on the off stump and he pushes this down to point
nearly lost his stumps there, he went down the track this time, swung and missed it and it just cleared the stumps
bowl short to McCullum at your own peril, Shami make the mistake this time and he pounds this over midwicket
appreciable inswing again, but it's starting a little too straight. McCullum struggles to maintain his balance while he tries to flick to midwicket
on the pads and McCullum's flicked it to the square leg boundary. Poor end to the over, he took the pace off the ball but ended up bowling a half-volley.
back of a length on middle to push the batsman back. McCullum blocks into the off side
this was full and pushing across him, McCullum's hands move towards the ball while his feet stay rooted. Finds the man at cover
back of a length and on the hips, Smith glances it away off his thighs and fine leg has a bit of work to do. Shami pulls out the boot on the last minute and saves a run
more swing! This was full and curls back in late. Smith loses his balance as he looks for a flick and wears one on the pads. Promising start for Parnell
little more bounce on this occasion as he goes back of a length. McCullum is cramped for room and guides it one-handed to deep third man
good length ball on off stump, pushed into the covers off a bit of an open face
angled into him on a good length and Smith works it away through square leg

cut him in half and the Daredevils have gone up in appeal. This time the ball ducks in after pitching and Smith is caught in his crease. Goes for an across-the-line flick and is glances the back pad. Ump says it was too high

this time he goes full and though the ball swings away, Smith leans into a square drive. He had to reach out a little and that made the top hand come off the bat. But it didn't hamper the power on the stroke
and he's in business straight away! Just back of a length and it darts away off the flashing blade of Smith. Good zip off the deck
